title: Hotel giant Wyndham exposed customer data after app security lapse | TechCrunch
summary: Security researcher Robert Wiggins at What Security exclusively told TechCrunch that he found a password inside the source code of Wyndham’s Android app, which granted access to an internal company database, hosted by tech company Salesforce.
